arxiv-2309-17002.title: Understanding and Mitigating the Label Noise in Pre-training on Downstream Tasks
arxiv-2309-17002.creator: Hao Chen 1,2 , Jindong Wang 2 , Ankit Shah 1 , Ran Tao 1 , Hongxin Wei 3 , Xing Xie 2 , Masashi Sugiyama 4,5 , Bhiksha Raj 1,6
arxiv-2309-17002.description: Abstract Pre-training on large-scale datasets and then fine-tuning on downstream tasks have become a standard practice in deep learning. However, pre-training datasets, while inaccessible or too expensive to handle, often contain label noise that may adversely affect the generalization of the model and pose unexpected risks.

arxiv-2412-09239.title: Application of quantum annealing for scalable robotic assembly line optimization: a case study
arxiv-2412-09239.creator: Moritz Willmann, Marcel Albus, Jan Schnabel, Marco Roth
arxiv-2412-09239.description: Abstract The even distribution and optimization of tasks across resources and workstations is a critical process in manufacturing aimed at maximizing efficiency, productivity, and profitability, known as Robotic Assembly Line Balancing (RALB) . With the increasing complexity of manufacturing required by mass customization, traditional computational approaches struggle to solve RALB problems efficiently.

pmc-11342617.title: Role of the sympathetic nervous system in cancer-associated cachexia and tumor progression in tumor-bearing BALB/c mice
pmc-11342617.creator: Isaias Gutierrez-Leal, Diana Caballero-Hernández, Alonso A. Orozco-Flores, Ricardo Gomez-Flores, Deyanira Quistián-Martínez, Patricia Tamez-Guerra, Reyes Tamez-Guerra, Cristina Rodríguez-Padilla

pmc-11660034.title: Electrode Elastic Modulus as the Dominant Factor in the Capping Effect in Ferroelectric Hafnium Zirconium Oxide Thin Films
pmc-11660034.creator: Megan
pmc-11660034.description: The discovery of ferroelectricity in hafnia based thin films has catalyzed significant research focused on understanding the ferroelectric property origins and means to increase stability of the ferroelectric phase. Prior studies have revealed that biaxial tensile stress via an electrode “capping effect” is a suspected ferroelectric phase stabilization mechanism.

pmc-12529897.title: Understanding DFT Uncertainties for More Reliable Reactivity Predictions by Advancing the Analysis of Error Sources
pmc-12529897.creator: Gergely Laczkó, Imre Pápai, Péter R. Nagy
pmc-12529897.description: Decades of advancements and thousands of successful applications have contributed to the reliability of density functional theory (DFT) methods. Especially in main group chemistry, DFT predictions tend to be increasingly more reliable. In this study, we deeply analyze unexpected (ca. 8–13 kcal/mol) DFT disagreements obtained for a few organic reactions using only widely adopted, modern, hybrid, and higher-rung DFT methods.

pmc-13379891.title: A Case of Nonanatomic Alignment: Acute Radial Head Dislocation Following Radial Shaft Osteosynthesis
pmc-13379891.creator: Khalid H. Almaazmi, Saif S. Aldhuhoori
pmc-13379891.description: Radial head dislocation after both bone forearm fractures (BBFF) fixation is rare. The management of BBFF involves open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) to restore anatomy and function. Anatomic reduction of the radius and ulna is required to restore the unique geometric relationship of the forearm and allow normal rotation.

pmc-13656312.title: Single-cell and intercellular communication analyses reveal DLL3 as a key regulator in the glioma tumor microenvironment
pmc-13656312.creator: Lei Xie, Han Wang, Xianrun Pan, Zhaoxi Yang, Jing Hu, Yuncong Zhang, Hao Qian
pmc-13656312.description: Glioma progression is increasingly recognized as a process driven not only by intrinsic genetic alterations in tumor cells but also by dynamic interactions within the tumor microenvironment (TME). However, systematic insight into the remodeling of intercellular communication networks during glioma evolution and their role in tumor progression remains limited.
